---
title: "Sketching Workflows"
---

A scientific workflow is more than a list of tasks. It shows how the different parts of a scientific process fit together — including data collection, preprocessing, analysis, decisions, parameter choices, and outputs.
In this activity, you will practice turning a short scientific description into a visual workflow.

## Choose a scenario

Choose one of the scenarios below based on the field that feels most familiar or interesting to you. You do not need specialized knowledge of the topic, and you only need to complete one scenario.

For your chosen scenario, you will:  
1. identify the major steps in the scientific process,  
2. create and arrange those steps on a canvas,  
3. connect them to show how the workflow progresses,  
4. include important choices or parameter values needed for reproducibility,  
5. compare your workflow with the answer.

Choose one scenario to complete:

::: {.panel-tabset #workflow-scenarios}

## Hydrology

**Scenario: Quality**

**Scientific question:**  
*Does water quality change as a stream flows past a developed area?*

A research team collects water samples from several stations upstream and downstream of a developed area. Each sample is labeled with its station number and collection date, and the team measures its nitrate concentration. Their measurement method is valid for nitrate concentrations between 0 and 50 mg/L.

Before analyzing the data, they:

- convert all nitrate measurements to the same units,
- average duplicate measurements collected at the same station on the same date,
- remove measurements without a completed quality-control check,
- discard nitrate values greater than 50 mg/L, outside the valid measurement range.

They then calculate the average nitrate concentration at each station and plot how nitrate levels change along the stream.

## Seismology

**Scenario: Earthquake frequency**

**Scientific question:**  

*Where are earthquakes occurring most frequently in a region?*

A research team uses an earthquake catalog containing the event identifier, date and time, location, and magnitude of each recorded earthquake. The catalog is considered complete for earthquakes of magnitude 2.0 or greater between 2015 and 2024.

Before analyzing the data, they:

- remove duplicate records with the same event identifier,
- remove records without a latitude or longitude,
- retain earthquakes recorded between 2015 and 2024,
- discard earthquakes with magnitudes below 2.0.

They then divide the region into 10 × 10 km grid cells, count the earthquakes within each cell, and create a map showing the number of earthquakes across the region.

## Oceanography

**Scenario: Ocean temperature profile**

**Scientific question:**  

*How does ocean temperature change with depth?*

A research team collects several ocean temperature profiles at the same location. Each measurement includes the profile identifier, depth, temperature, and a quality-control flag.

Before analyzing the data, they:

- convert all depths to meters,
- convert all temperatures to degrees Celsius,
- remove measurements without a completed quality-control check,
- retain measurements from the upper 500 meters of the ocean.

They then divide the water column into 10-meter depth intervals, calculate the average temperature within each interval, and plot average temperature against depth.

## Geophysics

**Scenario: Ground movement**

**Scientific question:**  

*Is the ground moving in this area over time?*

A research team uses daily position measurements from several GNSS stations. Each measurement includes the station identifier, date, east–west and north–south position, measurement uncertainty, and a quality-control flag.

Before analyzing the data, they:

- convert all positions to a common reference frame and units,
- remove measurements without a completed quality-control check,
- discard measurements with horizontal uncertainty greater than 10 mm,
- retain stations with at least three years of observations.

For each remaining station, they fit linear trends to the east–west and north–south positions over time. They combine the two trends to calculate the speed and direction of ground movement and plot the resulting velocity arrows on a map.

:::

## Sketch your workflow

Turn the scientific process above into a workflow.

Create as many steps as you think you need, arrange them on the canvas, and connect them to show how information moves through the analysis. Each step should include an input data (with optional parameters), an analysis, and an output. Intermediate outputs can be used as inputs for later steps.

**Remember:** Include choices and parameter values that someone would need to reproduce the workflow. For example, don't just write *remove invalid values* if the description tells you exactly what counts as invalid.

```{=html}

<div class="workflow-builder">

  <div class="workflow-toolbar">
    <button id="add-data" class="workflow-btn data-btn">
      + Data
    </button>

    <button id="add-analysis" class="workflow-btn analysis-btn">
      + Analysis
    </button>

    <button id="add-parameter" class="workflow-btn parameter-btn">
      + Parameter
    </button>

    <button id="connect-mode" class="workflow-btn">
      Connect: off
    </button>

    <button
        id="delete-connection"
        class="workflow-btn"
        disabled>
        Delete connection
    </button>

    <button id="clear-workflow" class="workflow-btn">
      Clear
    </button>
  </div>

  <p class="workflow-instructions">
    Add components to your workflow and describe each one. You can move components around the canvas by dragging the ⠿ handle.
    Turn <strong>Connect</strong> on, then click the component an arrow
    should start from followed by the component it should point to.
  </p>

  <div id="workflow-canvas" class="workflow-canvas">

    <svg
      id="workflow-lines"
      class="workflow-lines"
      aria-hidden="true">
    </svg>

    <div id="workflow-placeholder" class="workflow-placeholder">
      Add data, analysis steps, and parameters to begin.
    </div>

  </div>

</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  const canvas = document.getElementById("workflow-canvas");
  const svg = document.getElementById("workflow-lines");
  const placeholder = document.getElementById("workflow-placeholder");

  const addData = document.getElementById("add-data");
  const addAnalysis = document.getElementById("add-analysis");
  const addParameter = document.getElementById("add-parameter");

  const connectButton = document.getElementById("connect-mode");
  const deleteConnectionButton =
    document.getElementById("delete-connection");

  const clearButton =
    document.getElementById("clear-workflow");

  const downloadButton =
    document.getElementById("download-workflow");

  const showAnswerButton =
    document.getElementById("show-answer");

  const answerPanel =
    document.getElementById("workflow-answer");

  const answerTitle =
    document.getElementById("workflow-answer-title");

  const answerIntro =
    document.getElementById("workflow-answer-intro");

  const answerCanvas =
    document.getElementById("answer-canvas");

  const answerSvg =
    document.getElementById("answer-lines");

  const answerNote =
    document.getElementById("workflow-answer-note");

  const message =
    document.getElementById("workflow-message");


  let componentCount = 0;
  let connectMode = false;
  let connectionStart = null;
  let selectedConnection = null;

  const connections = [];


  // ==================================================
  // ADD COMPONENTS
  // ==================================================

  addData.addEventListener("click", () => {
    createComponent("data", "Data");
  });

  addAnalysis.addEventListener("click", () => {
    createComponent("analysis", "Analysis step");
  });

  addParameter.addEventListener("click", () => {
    createComponent("parameter", "Parameter");
  });


  // ==================================================
  // CONNECT MODE
  // ==================================================

  connectButton.addEventListener("click", () => {

    connectMode = !connectMode;

    connectButton.textContent =
      connectMode
        ? "Connect: on"
        : "Connect: off";

    connectButton.classList.toggle(
      "connect-active",
      connectMode
    );


    if (!connectMode && connectionStart) {

      connectionStart.classList.remove(
        "connection-selected"
      );

      connectionStart = null;

    }

  });


  // ==================================================
  // DELETE SELECTED CONNECTION
  // ==================================================

  deleteConnectionButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => {

      if (selectedConnection === null) return;

      connections.splice(
        selectedConnection,
        1
      );

      selectedConnection = null;

      deleteConnectionButton.disabled = true;

      drawConnections();

    }
  );


  // ==================================================
  // CLEAR WORKFLOW
  // ==================================================

  clearButton.addEventListener("click", () => {

    canvas
      .querySelectorAll(".workflow-component")
      .forEach(component => component.remove());

    connections.length = 0;

    componentCount = 0;
    connectionStart = null;
    selectedConnection = null;
    connectMode = false;

    connectButton.textContent =
      "Connect: off";

    connectButton.classList.remove(
      "connect-active"
    );

    deleteConnectionButton.disabled = true;

    placeholder.style.display = "block";

    message.textContent = "";

    drawConnections();

  });


  // ==================================================
  // CREATE COMPONENT
  // ==================================================

  function createComponent(type, label) {

    componentCount++;

    placeholder.style.display = "none";

    const component =
      document.createElement("div");

    component.className =
      `workflow-component workflow-${type}`;

    component.dataset.id =
      componentCount;


    component.style.left =
      `${30 + ((componentCount - 1) % 3) * 230}px`;

    component.style.top =
      `${30 + Math.floor((componentCount - 1) / 3) * 130}px`;


    component.innerHTML = `
      <div class="workflow-component-header">

        <span class="workflow-handle">
          ⠿
        </span>

        <span class="workflow-component-label">
          ${label}
        </span>

        <button
          type="button"
          class="workflow-delete"
          aria-label="Delete ${label}">
          ×
        </button>

      </div>

      <textarea
        class="workflow-component-text"
        placeholder="Describe ${label.toLowerCase()}..."
        aria-label="${label}">
      </textarea>
    `;


    canvas.appendChild(component);


    // ----------------------------------------------
    // Delete component
    // ----------------------------------------------

    const deleteButton =
      component.querySelector(
        ".workflow-delete"
      );


    deleteButton.addEventListener(
      "click",
      event => {

        event.stopPropagation();

        const id =
          component.dataset.id;


        for (
          let i = connections.length - 1;
          i >= 0;
          i--
        ) {

          if (
            connections[i].from === id ||
            connections[i].to === id
          ) {

            connections.splice(i, 1);

          }

        }


        if (
          connectionStart === component
        ) {

          connectionStart = null;

        }


        selectedConnection = null;

        deleteConnectionButton.disabled =
          true;


        component.remove();


        if (
          canvas.querySelectorAll(
            ".workflow-component"
          ).length === 0
        ) {

          placeholder.style.display =
            "block";

        }


        drawConnections();

      }
    );


    makeDraggable(component);


    // ----------------------------------------------
    // Select component for connection
    // ----------------------------------------------

    component.addEventListener(
      "click",
      event => {

        if (!connectMode) return;


        if (
          event.target.tagName === "TEXTAREA" ||
          event.target.classList.contains(
            "workflow-handle"
          ) ||
          event.target.classList.contains(
            "workflow-delete"
          )
        ) {

          return;

        }


        handleConnection(component);

      }
    );

  }


  // ==================================================
  // BUILD CONNECTION
  // ==================================================

  function handleConnection(component) {

    if (!connectionStart) {

      connectionStart = component;

      component.classList.add(
        "connection-selected"
      );

      return;

    }


    if (connectionStart === component) {

      connectionStart.classList.remove(
        "connection-selected"
      );

      connectionStart = null;

      return;

    }


    const from =
      connectionStart.dataset.id;

    const to =
      component.dataset.id;


    const alreadyExists =
      connections.some(
        connection =>
          connection.from === from &&
          connection.to === to
      );


    if (!alreadyExists) {

      connections.push({
        from: from,
        to: to
      });

    }


    connectionStart.classList.remove(
      "connection-selected"
    );

    connectionStart = null;

    selectedConnection = null;

    deleteConnectionButton.disabled =
      true;

    drawConnections();

  }


  // ==================================================
  // DRAW WORKFLOW CONNECTIONS
  // ==================================================

  function drawConnections() {

    svg.innerHTML = `
      <defs>

        <marker
          id="workflow-arrow"
          markerWidth="10"
          markerHeight="10"
          refX="9"
          refY="3"
          orient="auto"
          markerUnits="strokeWidth">

          <path
            d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z">
          </path>

        </marker>

      </defs>
    `;


    const canvasRect =
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect();


    connections.forEach(
      (connection, index) => {

        const from =
          canvas.querySelector(
            `[data-id="${connection.from}"]`
          );

        const to =
          canvas.querySelector(
            `[data-id="${connection.to}"]`
          );


        if (!from || !to) return;


        const fromRect =
          from.getBoundingClientRect();

        const toRect =
          to.getBoundingClientRect();


        const x1 =
          fromRect.left -
          canvasRect.left +
          fromRect.width / 2;

        const y1 =
          fromRect.top -
          canvasRect.top +
          fromRect.height / 2;

        const x2 =
          toRect.left -
          canvasRect.left +
          toRect.width / 2;

        const y2 =
          toRect.top -
          canvasRect.top +
          toRect.height / 2;


        const line =
          document.createElementNS(
            "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
            "line"
          );


        line.setAttribute("x1", x1);
        line.setAttribute("y1", y1);
        line.setAttribute("x2", x2);
        line.setAttribute("y2", y2);

        line.setAttribute(
          "marker-end",
          "url(#workflow-arrow)"
        );

        line.classList.add(
          "workflow-arrow"
        );


        if (
          selectedConnection === index
        ) {

          line.classList.add(
            "workflow-arrow-selected"
          );

        }


        line.addEventListener(
          "click",
          event => {

            event.stopPropagation();

            selectedConnection = index;

            deleteConnectionButton.disabled =
              false;

            drawConnections();

          }
        );


        svg.appendChild(line);

      }
    );

  }


  // ==================================================
  // DRAG COMPONENTS
  // ==================================================

  function makeDraggable(component) {

    const handle =
      component.querySelector(
        ".workflow-handle"
      );


    let dragging = false;

    let offsetX = 0;
    let offsetY = 0;


    handle.addEventListener(
      "pointerdown",
      event => {

        dragging = true;

        const rect =
          component.getBoundingClientRect();

        offsetX =
          event.clientX - rect.left;

        offsetY =
          event.clientY - rect.top;


        handle.setPointerCapture(
          event.pointerId
        );

      }
    );


    handle.addEventListener(
      "pointermove",
      event => {

        if (!dragging) return;


        const canvasRect =
          canvas.getBoundingClientRect();


        let x =
          event.clientX -
          canvasRect.left -
          offsetX;

        let y =
          event.clientY -
          canvasRect.top -
          offsetY;


        x = Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(
            x,
            canvas.clientWidth -
            component.offsetWidth
          )
        );

        y = Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(
            y,
            canvas.clientHeight -
            component.offsetHeight
          )
        );


        component.style.left =
          `${x}px`;

        component.style.top =
          `${y}px`;


        drawConnections();

      }
    );


    handle.addEventListener(
      "pointerup",
      event => {

        dragging = false;


        if (
          handle.hasPointerCapture(
            event.pointerId
          )
        ) {

          handle.releasePointerCapture(
            event.pointerId
          );

        }

      }
    );


    handle.addEventListener(
      "pointercancel",
      event => {

        dragging = false;


        if (
          handle.hasPointerCapture(
            event.pointerId
          )
        ) {

          handle.releasePointerCapture(
            event.pointerId
          );

        }

      }
    );

  }


  // ==================================================
  // FIND ACTIVE SCENARIO TAB
  // ==================================================

  function getActiveScenario() {

    const activeTab =
      document.querySelector(
        "#workflow-scenarios .nav-link.active"
      );


    if (!activeTab) {

      return "hydrology";

    }


    return activeTab
      .textContent
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  }


  // ==================================================
  // SHOW ANSWER
  // ==================================================

  showAnswerButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => {

      const opening =
        answerPanel.hidden;


      answerPanel.hidden =
        !answerPanel.hidden;


      showAnswerButton.textContent =
        opening
          ? "Hide the answer"
          : "Show the answer";


      if (opening) {

        const scenario =
          getActiveScenario();

        renderAnswer(scenario);

      }

    }
  );


  // ==================================================
  // ROUTE TO CORRECT ANSWER
  // ==================================================

  function renderAnswer(scenario) {

    clearAnswerCanvas();


    if (scenario === "hydrology") {

      renderHydrologyAnswer();

      return;

    }


    if (scenario === "seismology") {

      renderSeismologyAnswer();

      return;

    }


    if (scenario === "oceanography") {

      renderOceanographyAnswer();

      return;

    }


    if (scenario === "geophysics") {

      renderGeophysicsAnswer();

      return;

    }


    renderUnavailableAnswer(scenario);

  }


  // ==================================================
  // CLEAR ANSWER AREA
  // ==================================================

  function clearAnswerCanvas() {

    answerCanvas

        ".answer-component"
      )
      .forEach(
        component =>
          component.remove()
      );


    answerSvg.innerHTML = "";

    answerIntro.innerHTML = "";

    answerNote.innerHTML = "";

  }

  function renderUnavailableAnswer(
    scenario
  ) {

    answerTitle.textContent =
      `${capitalize(scenario)}: Answer`;

      We have not added the reference workflow
      for this scenario yet.

  // ==================================================
  // BUILD ANSWER DIAGRAM
  // ==================================================

  function buildAnswerDiagram(
    nodes,
    answerConnections
  ) {

    nodes.forEach(node => {

      const component =
        document.createElement("div");


      component.className =
        `workflow-component workflow-${node.type} answer-component`;


      component.dataset.answerId =
        node.id;


      component.style.left =
        `${node.x}px`;

      component.style.top =
        `${node.y}px`;


      component.innerHTML = `
        <div class="workflow-component-header">

          <span class="workflow-component-label">
            ${node.label}
          </span>

        </div>

        <div class="answer-component-text">
          ${node.text}
        </div>
      `;


      answerCanvas.appendChild(
        component
      );

    });


    requestAnimationFrame(() => {

      drawAnswerConnections(
        answerConnections
      );

    });

  }


  // ==================================================
  // DRAW ANSWER CONNECTIONS
  // ==================================================

  function drawAnswerConnections(
    answerConnections
    ) {

    answerSvg.innerHTML = `
        <defs>

        <marker
            id="answer-arrow"
            markerWidth="10"
            markerHeight="10"
            refX="9"
            refY="3"
            orient="auto"
            markerUnits="strokeWidth">

            <path
            d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z">
            </path>

        </marker>

        </defs>
    `;


    const canvasRect =
        answerCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();


    answerConnections.forEach(
        connection => {

        const from =
            answerCanvas.querySelector(
            `[data-answer-id="${connection[0]}"]`
            );

        const to =
            answerCanvas.querySelector(
            `[data-answer-id="${connection[1]}"]`
            );


        if (!from || !to) return;


        const fromRect =
            from.getBoundingClientRect();

        const toRect =
            to.getBoundingClientRect();


        const fromCenter = {
            x:
            fromRect.left -
            canvasRect.left +
            fromRect.width / 2,

            y:
            fromRect.top -
            canvasRect.top +
            fromRect.height / 2
        };


        const toCenter = {
            x:
            toRect.left -
            canvasRect.left +
            toRect.width / 2,

            y:
            toRect.top -
            canvasRect.top +
            toRect.height / 2
        };


        const start =
            boxEdgePoint(
            fromCenter,
            toCenter,
            fromRect.width,
            fromRect.height
            );


        const end =
            boxEdgePoint(
            toCenter,
            fromCenter,
            toRect.width,
            toRect.height
            );


        const line =
            document.createElementNS(
            "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
            "line"
            );


        line.setAttribute(
            "x1",
            start.x
        );

        line.setAttribute(
            "y1",
            start.y
        );

        line.setAttribute(
            "x2",
            end.x
        );

        line.setAttribute(
            "y2",
            end.y
        );


        line.setAttribute(
            "marker-end",
            "url(#answer-arrow)"
        );

        line.classList.add(
            "workflow-arrow"
        );


        answerSvg.appendChild(line);

        }
    );

    }


    function boxEdgePoint(
    center,
    target,
    width,
    height
    ) {

    const dx =
        target.x - center.x;

    const dy =
        target.y - center.y;


    if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) {

        return center;

    }


    const scaleX =
        dx !== 0
        ? (width / 2) / Math.abs(dx)
        : Infinity;

    const scaleY =
        dy !== 0
        ? (height / 2) / Math.abs(dy)
        : Infinity;


    const scale =
        Math.min(
        scaleX,
        scaleY
        );


    return {

        x:
        center.x +
        dx * scale,

        y:
        center.y +
        dy * scale

    };

    }


  // ==================================================
  // DOWNLOAD WORKFLOW AS SVG
  // ==================================================

  downloadButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    downloadWorkflow
  );


  function downloadWorkflow() {

    const components =
      Array.from(
        canvas.querySelectorAll(
          ".workflow-component"
        )
      );


    if (
      components.length === 0
    ) {

      message.textContent =
        "Add at least one component before downloading.";

      return;

    }


    message.textContent = "";


    const canvasRect =
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect();


    const width =
      canvas.clientWidth;

    const height =
      canvas.clientHeight;


    const nodeInfo =
      new Map();


    components.forEach(
      component => {

        const rect =
          component.getBoundingClientRect();


        nodeInfo.set(
          component.dataset.id,
          {

            x:
              rect.left -
              canvasRect.left,

            y:
              rect.top -
              canvasRect.top,

            width:
              rect.width,

            height:
              rect.height,

            type:
              component.classList.contains(
                "workflow-data"
              )
                ? "data"
                : component.classList.contains(
                    "workflow-analysis"
                  )
                ? "analysis"
                : "parameter",

            text:
              component.querySelector(
                ".workflow-component-text"
              ).value

          }
        );

      }
    );


    let svgContent = `
      <svg
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        width="${width}"
        height="${height}"
        viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}">

        <rect
          width="100%"
          height="100%"
          fill="white"/>

        <defs>

          <marker
            id="download-arrow"
            markerWidth="10"
            markerHeight="10"
            refX="9"
            refY="3"
            orient="auto">

            <path
              d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z"
              fill="#495057"/>

          </marker>

        </defs>
    `;


    // ----------------------------------------------
    // Download arrows
    // ----------------------------------------------

    connections.forEach(
      connection => {

        const from =
          nodeInfo.get(
            connection.from
          );

        const to =
          nodeInfo.get(
            connection.to
          );


        if (!from || !to) return;


        svgContent += `
          <line
            x1="${from.x + from.width / 2}"
            y1="${from.y + from.height / 2}"
            x2="${to.x + to.width / 2}"
            y2="${to.y + to.height / 2}"
            stroke="#495057"
            stroke-width="2.5"
            marker-end="url(#download-arrow)"/>
        `;

      }
    );


    // ----------------------------------------------
    // Download components
    // ----------------------------------------------

    nodeInfo.forEach(
      node => {

        let border;
        let header;


        if (node.type === "data") {

          border = "#4c78a8";
          header = "#dce8f5";

        }

        else if (
          node.type === "analysis"
        ) {

          border = "#59a14f";
          header = "#e1f0df";

        }

        else {

          border = "#f28e2b";
          header = "#fae7d3";

        }


        const title =
          node.type === "data"
            ? "Data"
            : node.type === "analysis"
            ? "Analysis step"
            : "Parameter";


        svgContent += `
          <rect
            x="${node.x}"
            y="${node.y}"
            width="${node.width}"
            height="${node.height}"
            rx="8"
            fill="white"
            stroke="${border}"
            stroke-width="2"/>

          <rect
            x="${node.x}"
            y="${node.y}"
            width="${node.width}"
            height="32"
            rx="8"
            fill="${header}"/>

          <text
            x="${node.x + 10}"
            y="${node.y + 21}"
            font-family="Arial, sans-serif"
            font-size="13"
            font-weight="bold"
            fill="#212529">

            ${escapeXML(title)}

          </text>
        `;


        const lines =
          wrapText(
            node.text ||
            "(no description)",
            28
          );


        lines.forEach(
          (line, index) => {

            svgContent += `
              <text
                x="${node.x + 10}"
                y="${node.y + 52 + index * 17}"
                font-family="Arial, sans-serif"
                font-size="13"
                fill="#212529">

                ${escapeXML(line)}

              </text>
            `;

          }
        );

      }
    );


    svgContent += `
      </svg>
    `;


    const blob =
      new Blob(
        [svgContent],
        {
          type:
            "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"
        }
      );


    const url =
      URL.createObjectURL(blob);


    const link =
      document.createElement("a");


    const scenario =
      getActiveScenario();


    link.href = url;

    link.download =
      `${scenario}-workflow.svg`;


    document.body.appendChild(link);

    link.click();

    link.remove();


    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);


    message.textContent =
      "Workflow downloaded.";

  }


  // ==================================================
  // HELPERS
  // ==================================================

  function wrapText(
    text,
    maxLength
  ) {

    const words =
      text.trim().split(/\s+/);

    const lines = [];

    let line = "";


    words.forEach(word => {

      const test =
        line
          ? `${line} ${word}`
          : word;


      if (
        test.length >
        maxLength &&
        line
      ) {

        lines.push(line);

        line = word;

      }

      else {

        line = test;

      }

    });


    if (line) {

      lines.push(line);

    }


    return lines.slice(0, 4);

  }


  function escapeXML(text) {

    return text
      .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
      .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
      .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
      .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
      .replaceAll("'", "&apos;");

  }


  function capitalize(text) {

    return (
      text.charAt(0).toUpperCase() +
      text.slice(1)
    );

  }


  // ==================================================
  // RESIZE
  // ==================================================

  window.addEventListener(
    "resize",
    () => {

      drawConnections();


      if (!answerPanel.hidden) {

        const scenario =
          getActiveScenario();

        renderAnswer(
          scenario
        );

      }

    }
  );

});
</script>

<div class="workflow-output-actions">

  <button
    id="download-workflow"
    class="workflow-btn">
    Download workflow
  </button>

  <button
    id="show-answer"
    class="workflow-btn">
    Show the answer
  </button>

  <span
    id="workflow-message"
    class="workflow-message"
    aria-live="polite">
  </span>

</div>


<div
  id="workflow-answer"
  class="workflow-answer"
  hidden>

  <h3 id="workflow-answer-title">
    Answer
  </h3>

  <p id="workflow-answer-intro"></p>

  <div class="workflow-answer-scroll">

    <div
      id="answer-canvas"
      class="workflow-canvas workflow-answer-canvas">

      <svg
        id="answer-lines"
        class="workflow-lines"
        aria-hidden="true">
      </svg>

    </div>

  </div>

  <div
    id="workflow-answer-note"
    class="workflow-answer-note">
  </div>

</div>
```
